Net Neutrality is the concept that your ISP should give you a pipe to the Internet and should not restrict or shape your traffic for their monetary gain.

Consumer Internet service is a natural monopoly in that the government provides easements that the utility can place their communication lines on, but by necessity must limit the number of providers they allow to do so. So, consumer Internet service is not a free market, but a government subsidized monopoly/duopoly. The same applies to cellular/satellite internet. The government controls an extremely limited resource (uncongested radio frequencies), and allows companies to use that resource to provide a service to consumers.
